blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Children under 6 months of age: Consult a licensed healthcare practitioner before using this product.
Children 6 months to 2 years old: 0.5 ml orally every 8 hours or 3 times a day
Children 2 to 9 years old: 0.75 ml orally every 8 hour or 3 times a day

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Colocynthis 6X (Bitter apple)	abdominal bloating, colic and nausea
Magnesia phosphorica 6X (Magnesium hydrogen phosphate)	abdominal cramps
Chamomilla 6X (German chamomile)	nausea, agitation and irritability
Dioscorea villosa 6X (Wild yam)	intestinal gas, burping and colic-like pain
The letter 'HPUS' indicate that the components in this product are officially monographed in the Homeopathic Pharmacopoeia of the United States.
Inactive Ingredients: Purified water, sorbitol, raspberry and grape flavor, sodium benzoate, potassium sorbate, citric acid.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Do use if seal is broken or missing.
Stop use and ask a doctor in cases of high fever or if symptoms worsen or persist for more than 2 days.
Keep out of reach of children.
